Completes the pair with the Stocking co-play prompt already in COPLAY (from the earlier bulk prompt batch: hang a stocking or a big sock on a hook saying 'hang… hang!', hide a big soft toy inside saying 'where did it go?', then reach in and pull it out saying 'peek-a-boo… there it is!', take turns hiding and finding — any hide counts; only big soft toys go in the stocking, no coins, no small balls, no hard candy, and a grown-up does the hanging and checks what's inside). Stocking research: by age 2 children turn the tables on object permanence — they hide things for you to find and play with the hiding themselves (Made for Mums); hiding a favourite toy and encouraging the child to find it is the canonical form, and the stocking is a festive container version of it; the 'where did it go?… there it is!' reveal is the delight — anticipation and surprise are the payoff, with no correctness demand.
